444:   for( idx = 0 ; idx < len ; idx ++)

448:       pbuf[ 2* idx] = (value >> 28) + '0';
449:     }
450:     else
451:     {
452:       pbuf[2* idx] = (value >> 28) + 'A' - 10; 
453:     }
454:     
455:     value = value << 4;
456:

364: void I2S_CODEC_ForwardPlay(uint32_t Step)
365: {
366:   /* Pause Playing the audio file */
367:   I2S_CODEC_Pause();
368: 
369:   /* Increment the Audio pointer */
370:   IncrementVar_AudioDataIndex((AudioDataLength / 100) * Step);
371: 
372:   /* Insure the index parity */
373:   AudioDataIndex &= 0xFFFFFFFE;
374: 
375:   /* Resume playing from the new position */
376:   I2S_CODEC_Play((GetVar_AudioDataIndex()));
377: }
378:

386: void I2S_CODEC_RewindPlay(uint32_t Step)
387: {
388:   /* Pause Playing the audio file */
389:   I2S_CODEC_Pause();
390: 
391:   /* Increment the Audio pointer */
392:   DecrementVar_AudioDataIndex((AudioDataLength / 100) * Step);
393: 
394:   /* Insure the index parity */
395:   AudioDataIndex &= 0xFFFFFFFE;
396: 
397:   /* Resume playing from the new position */
398:   I2S_CODEC_Play((GetVar_AudioDataIndex()));
399: }
400:

433: {
434:   /* Power Down the Codec */
435:   GPIO_ResetBits(Codec_PDN_GPIO, Codec_PDN_Pin);
436: 
437:   /* wait for a delay to allow registers erasing */
438:   delay(0xFF);
439: 
440:   /* Power On the Codec after the power off => all registers are reinitialized*/
441:   GPIO_SetBits(Codec_PDN_GPIO, Codec_PDN_Pin);
442: 
443: }
444:

590: {
591:   uint8_t idx = 0;
592:   
593:   for( idx = 0 ; idx < len ; idx ++)
594:   {
595:     if( ((value >> 28)) < 0xA )
596:     {
597:       pbuf[ 2* idx] = (value >> 28) + '0';
598:     }
599:     else
600:     {
601:       pbuf[2* idx] = (value >> 28) + 'A' - 10; 
602:     }
603:     
604:     value = value << 4;
605:     
```

324: void Bot_Abort(uint8_t Direction)
325: {

330:       break;
331:     case DIR_OUT :

333:       break;
334:     case BOTH_DIR :
335:       SetEPTxStatus(ENDP2, EP_TX_STALL);
336:       SetEPRxStatus(ENDP2, EP_RX_STALL);
337:       break;
338:     default:
339:       break;
340:   }
```

564:   for( idx = 0 ; idx < len ; idx ++)

570:     else
571:     {
572:       pbuf[2* idx] = (value >> 28) + 'A' - 10; 
573:     }
574:     
575:     value = value << 4;
576:     
```

以下为原始源码，不是截图OCR。
```
385: static void IntToUnicode (uint32_t value , uint8_t *pbuf , uint8_t len)
386: {
387:   uint8_t idx = 0;
388:   
389:   for( idx = 0 ; idx < len ; idx ++)
390:   {
391:     if( ((value >> 28)) < 0xA )
392:     {
393:       pbuf[ 2* idx] = (value >> 28) + '0';
394:     }
395:     else
396:     {
397:       pbuf[2* idx] = (value >> 28) + 'A' - 10; 
398:     }
399:     
400:     value = value << 4;
401:     
```

91:     DataLength += 1;
92:     MAL_Buffer[DataLength-1] = 0xFF;
93:   }
94:   
95:   FSMC_NOR_WriteBuffer((uint16_t *)MAL_Buffer, (Address&0x00FFFFFF), DataLength >> 1);  
96:   
97:   return MAL_OK;
98: }
99: 
100: /*******************************************************************************
```

514: static void IntToUnicode (uint32_t value , uint8_t *pbuf , uint8_t len)
515: {
516:   uint8_t idx = 0;
517:   
518:   for( idx = 0 ; idx < len ; idx ++)
519:   {
520:     if( ((value >> 28)) < 0xA )
521:     {
522:       pbuf[ 2* idx] = (value >> 28) + '0';
523:     }
524:     else
525:     {
526:       pbuf[2* idx] = (value >> 28) + 'A' - 10; 
527:     }
528:     
529:     value = value << 4;
530:     
```

324: void Bot_Abort(uint8_t Direction)
325: {
326:   switch (Direction)
327:   {
328:     case DIR_IN :
329:       SetEPTxStatus(ENDP1, EP_TX_STALL);
330:       break;
331:     case DIR_OUT :

333:       break;
334:     case BOTH_DIR :
335:       SetEPTxStatus(ENDP1, EP_TX_STALL);
336:       SetEPRxStatus(ENDP2, EP_RX_STALL);
337:       break;
338:     default:
339:       break;
340:   }
```

410: bool SCSI_Address_Management(uint8_t lun , uint8_t Cmd , uint32_t LBA , uint32_t BlockNbr)
411: {
412:   if ((LBA + BlockNbr) > Mass_Block_Count[lun] )
413:   {
414:     if (Cmd == SCSI_WRITE10)
415:     {
416:       Bot_Abort(BOTH_DIR);

415:

421:     while(USART_GetFlagStatus(EVAL_COM1, USART_FLAG_TXE) == RESET); 
422:   }  
423: }
424:

52:   *                  The SD Card frequency (SDIO_CK) is computed as follows:
53:   *
54:   *                     +---------------------------------------------+
55:   *                     | SDIO_CK = SDIOCLK / (SDIO_INIT_CLK_DIV + 2) |
```

2791:     count++;
2792:   }

164: ErrorStatus LM75_GetStatus(void)
165: {  
166:   /* Test if LM75 is ready */
167:   while ((LM75_Status() == CPAL_FAIL) && LM75_Timeout)  
168:   {
169:     LM75_Timeout--;
170:   }
171:   
172:   /* If LM75 is not responding return ERROR */
173:   if (LM75_Timeout == 0)
174:   {
175:     return ERROR;
176:   }
177:   
178:   /* In other case return SUCCESS */
179:   return SUCCESS;  
180: }
181: /**
```

237: void SRAM_WriteBuffer(uint16_t* pBuffer, uint32_t WriteAddr, uint32_t NumHalfwordToWrite)
238: {
239:   for(; NumHalfwordToWrite != 0; NumHalfwordToWrite--) /*!< while there is data to write */
240:   {
241:     /*!< Transfer data to the memory */
242:     *(uint16_t *) (Bank1_SRAM3_ADDR + WriteAddr) = *pBuffer++;
243:     
244:     /*!< Increment the address*/  
245:     WriteAddr += 2;
246:   }   
247: }

137: SD_Error SD_Init(void)
138: {
139:   uint32_t i = 0;
140: 
141:   /*!< Initialize SD_SPI */
142:   SD_LowLevel_Init(); 
143: 
144:   /*!< SD chip select high */
145:   SD_CS_HIGH();
146: 
147:   /*!< Send dummy byte 0xFF, 10 times with CS high */
148:   /*!< Rise CS and MOSI for 80 clocks cycles */
149:   for (i = 0; i <= 9; i++)
150:   {
151:     /*!< Send dummy byte 0xFF */
152:     SD_WriteByte(SD_DUMMY_BYTE);
153:   }
